jobs_results.description:
Chennai, Tamil Nadu

Job Summary

The Senior Developer will be responsible for developing and maintaining Python based applications within a microservices architecture deployed on cloud platforms. The role involves implementing, and optimizing scalable solutions that leverage Python, microservices, and cloud technologies to meet business requirements and enhance overall system performance.

Key Responsibilities

1. Developing, and testing python applications within a microservices architecture.

2. Implementing and optimizing restful apis for seamless integration of microservices.

3. Deploying and managing applications on cloud platforms such as aws, azure, or google cloud.

4. Collaborating within team to define technical requirements and ensure successful project delivery.

5. Troubleshooting and debugging issues to maintain application performance and reliability.

6. Implementing security best practices to protect data and infrastructure.

7. Conducting code reviews and providing technical guidance to junior developers.

Skill Requirements

1. Proficiency in python programming language and its libraries for developing efficient and maintainable code.

2. Strong understanding of microservices architecture and experience in designing and implementing microservices based solutions.

3. Handson experience with cloud services such as aws, azure, or google cloud for deploying and managing applications.

4. Knowledge of containerization technologies like docker and orchestration tools like kubernetes.

5. Familiarity with relational and nosql databases for data storage and retrieval.

6. Good problem-solving skills and ability to work in a fast paced environment.

7. Strong communication and teamwork skills to collaborate with diverse teams and stakeholders effectively.

Other Requirements

1.Relevant certifications in Python, microservices, or cloud technologies are a plus.

Backend Engineer – Python, FastAPI, Agentic AI & LLM

Job Title: Backend Engineer

Experience: 5–7 Years

Location: Guindy / OMR, Chennai

Work Mode: Work from Office – 5 Days a Week

Joining Preference: Immediate Joiners Preferred

About The Role

We are hiring an experienced Backend Engineer to build an enterprise SaaS product powered by agentic AI and large language models.

You will design and develop the backend services behind the product, including APIs, data services, AI integrations and the infrastructure required to operate the platform reliably at scale.

Key Responsibilities

Design and develop scalable backend services, REST APIs and microservices.Integrate large language models and AI services into production workflows.Build agentic AI capabilities involving tool use, structured outputs, prompt management and multi-step orchestration.Develop integration adapters for enterprise systems, databases and third-party APIs.Implement asynchronous processing using background workers, schedulers, events and webhooks.Contribute to multi-tenant architecture, access control and tenant-level data isolation.Build observability, monitoring and reliability into backend services.Participate in system design discussions, code reviews and technical decision-making.

Technical Stack

Python

 FastAPI PostgreSQL MongoDB Redis Docker Pydantic MinIO/S3 LLM APIs Git CI/CD

Required Experience And Skills

5–7 years of relevant backend development experience.Strong Python backend development experience using FastAPI, Django or Flask in production.Experience developing and scaling REST APIs and microservices used by real users.Strong knowledge of PostgreSQL and MongoDB, including schema design, query optimisation and migrations.Hands-on experience with Redis for caching, queuing or pub/sub.Production experience with LLMs or AI APIs, including prompt engineering, structured outputs and error handling.Experience with agentic AI patterns, RAG or AI orchestration frameworks.Strong understanding of event-driven and asynchronous architectures, message queues, background workers and task-processing frameworks.Hands-on experience with Docker and AWS or Azure cloud platforms.Experience working with multi-tenant systems, RBAC and tenant-scoped data management.Ability to write tested, maintainable code and proactively handle potential failure scenarios.

Why Join

This is an opportunity to join an early-stage enterprise product with a long-term roadmap. You will have meaningful ownership from the beginning and the opportunity to grow into architecture and technical leadership responsibilities as the engineering team expands.

Apply Now

Apply Through Our Careers Portal

https://letzbizz-jobs.zite.so

You May Also Send Your Updated Resume To

hr@letzbizz.com

Immediate joiners are preferred. This is strictly a Work-from-Office position for five days a week in Guindy / OMR, Chennai.

You may also refer suitable friends or professional contacts who match this requirement.
